name: Mithredath
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: He sends them back by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer and numbers them to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

note.label: Ezra 1: Cyrus Stirred Up to Send Israel Home
